title: Security fault matrix
description: Objective: run hostile credentials, stale authority, command replay, corruption, crash-at-boundary, poison, resource, and provider fault schedules across the full system. Deliverable: security/fault fixtures and exact evidence. NOT in scope: host-malicious sandbox claims. Hard dependencies: Schedule coverage checker and all production adapters. Owned paths: tests/security/** and tests/fault/**. Verification: pnpm test:fault && pnpm test:security.
definitionOfDone: Every declared authority and external-effect boundary has hostile before/after/race coverage.
No unauthorized mutation, duplicate effect, budget mint, hidden skip, or false evidence acceptance occurs.
Unobservable host behavior is labeled outside-scope or UNKNOWN precisely.
taskRails: Claims follow the benchmark permit-list; missing, partial, cross-basis, or unverifiable evidence is UNKNOWN, never PASS.
No confirmatory corpus is generated or viewed until the implementation commit is frozen exactly as specified.
GO_QUIESCE and GO_ACTIVATE are separate human decisions. Keep evidence exact, reproducible, and scoped to one source commit.

comments.author: architect-5b5302ee
comments.content:
Expanded planning audit (2026-08-09, HEAD 7afa17d), preserving the BLOCKED verdict.

This task is also too broad for one <=60-minute implementation slice once its production subjects exist: the committed tree currently exposes at least eight security surfaces and eight fault surfaces. Re-plan it as the FINAL integration/hardening proof after these file-disjoint test slices land:

1. Authority transport hostile matrix — tests/security/transports/**. Drive public production ingress for daemon HTTP/event stream, MCP stdio/Streamable HTTP, authenticated IDE/control-room, importer, and force paths. Case rows cover missing/malformed/expired/revoked/swapped/replayed credentials and stale version/epoch/binding/command/artifact identities. Each row pins exact stable code AND refusing layer/stage and reads authoritative state/effect/budget/audit deltas back as zero. Generated rows assert non-zero count and exact set equality with the production registry.
2. Integrity/scope hostile matrix — tests/security/integrity/**. Drive production path/scope, symlink/junction/submodule/UNC/device/case, malicious Git ref, argv/env, N/N+1 bounds, provider-closure swap, evidence substitution/tamper, redaction and distribution handshake surfaces. Same code/layer and zero-authority assertions; same production-registry non-vacuity ratchet.
3. Durable-store fault matrix — tests/fault/store/**. Real SQLite/subprocess schedules at transaction begin/write/commit/ack, WAL/checkpoint, corruption/permission/lock, outbox/inbox/projection poison and replay. Assert whole-or-none durable truth, exact STORE/OUTBOX code+layer, command replay idempotency, no lost acknowledged event, and no duplicate delivery. Test-produced helpers must not replace relay/controller production entry points.
4. Runtime/provider fault matrix — tests/fault/runtime/**. Drive production dispatcher/supervisor/platform/provider/resource/budget/artifact composition before/after/race at registration, lock, activation, physical start, result, ack, cancel and recovery. Assert one authoritative effect, no budget mint/slot/resource duplication, exact recovery/refusal code+layer, and honest UNKNOWN for unobservable host facts. Host-malicious same-user behavior is explicitly OUTSIDE_SCOPE, never PASS or skip.
5. Gate-lane wiring prerequisite — root package.json plus tests/fault/tsconfig.json and tests/security/tsconfig.json. Shell-neutral scripts must run strict tsc over all tests/** lane files before Vitest: pnpm test:fault and pnpm test:security. Root recursive typecheck does not cover tests/** today.
6. This task then owns the full-matrix ratchet and final proof only: verify every prerequisite shipping task is DONE and reachable from a real consumer, exact design/benchmark hashes and one source commit, no confirmatory corpus bytes, exhaustive production registry ↔ executed-case set equality, exact UNKNOWN/outside-scope rows, and one adversarial mutation per refusal layer plus one deleted-case non-vacuity mutation.
7. Final verification is exactly pnpm test:fault && pnpm test:security, followed by the epic-required path-attributed repo baseline comparison; no generated evidence file is committed.

Current missing subjects, verified on disk: daemon HTTP has injected Authenticator/DecisionPort but no real composition/root export; core authenticateCommand has test-only callers; event stream has no auth/listener; MCP stdio/HTTP have no daemon dispatch/session port (HTTP internals are not root-exported); importer has no authenticated command/store composition; control room main mounts fixtures; R3/force handlers are absent; outbox relay is internal/unconsumed; activateEffect/platform launcher/OS lock are unconsumed or absent; provider probes do not spawn/pin processes; budget settlement/artifact concrete edges are unconsumed; J3/J4 are in flight; Codex/JetBrains/distribution/platform prerequisites are not DONE. The schedule checker is DONE but its 10 refs are abstract categories, not an exhaustive production boundary registry.

Do not submit the parent plan until the new production-prerequisite task IDs are known; Clause 2 requires naming those shipping tasks in the acceptance plan. Preserve existing tests/fault/foundation/** (task-18c7921 DONE) and avoid disaster-restore/Linux/macOS owned subtrees.

comments.author: architect-5b5302ee
comments.content:
Second planning pass: concrete SPIDR child specifications and the eventual parent plan. These are blueprints only; do not create duplicates while architect-1721c07f owns prerequisite authoring.

CHILD A — Authority transport hostile schedules
- Owned files: tests/security/transports/authority-cases.ts, authority-matrix.test.ts, tsconfig.json.
- Objective/deliverable: a frozen, registry-derived matrix that drives the composed production daemon HTTP/event, MCP stdio/Streamable HTTP, control-room/IDE, importer, and R3 force entry points; no injected test-only authority port may stand in for a missing consumer edge.
- DoD: (1) case universe is non-empty and exact-set-equal to the versioned production authority registry, with BEFORE/AFTER/RACE for every boundary; (2) missing/malformed/expired/revoked/swapped/replayed credentials plus stale version/epoch/binding/command/artifact rows assert exact code and refusing layer/stage; (3) each refusal reads the authoritative store/effect/budget/audit surfaces and proves zero mutation/effect/mint while valid stale rejections are redacted/audited; (4) multiple-layer controls pin which layer refused and mutation of each layer makes its named row red; (5) pnpm exec tsc -p tests/security/transports/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec vitest run tests/security/transports exits 0.
- Not in scope: filesystem/provider integrity and effect crash scheduling.

CHILD B — Integrity boundary hostile schedules
- Owned files: tests/security/integrity/integrity-cases.ts, integrity-matrix.test.ts, tsconfig.json.
- Production surfaces: runner observeScope/createNodeScopePaths/createNodeGitObserver, workspace manifests, concrete artifact store, provider runtime closure/render/evidence validation, importer canonicalization, and signed distribution handshake.
- DoD: (1) production-registry exact-set equality plus non-zero N/N+1 rows; (2) path traversal, symlink/junction/submodule/UNC/device/case collision, malicious Git refs, argv/env injection, oversize, provider path swap, artifact/evidence substitution and tamper assert exact code+layer; (3) no hostile bytes, provider output, or evidence grant command/effect/lease/verification authority; (4) same-user malicious-host behavior is explicitly OUTSIDE_SCOPE/UNKNOWN, never skipped or PASS; (5) pnpm exec tsc -p tests/security/integrity/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec vitest run tests/security/integrity exits 0.
- Cross-platform: use Node path APIs and real platform observations; never POSIX quoting, /tmp, or fake signal claims.

CHILD C — Durable store fault schedules
- Owned files: tests/fault/store/store-fault-cases.ts, store-fault-matrix.test.ts, tsconfig.json.
- Production surfaces: public SqliteEventStore plus the future exported/consumed transactional relay; real SQLite/subprocess injection, never an in-memory reimplementation.
- DoD: (1) registry-derived BEFORE/AFTER/RACE cases cover transaction begin/write/commit/ack, WAL/checkpoint, disk/permission/lock/corruption, outbox/inbox/projection poison/replay; (2) every failure pins exact STORE/OUTBOX code+layer and reads whole-or-none durable state; (3) replays produce one decision/effect/delivery and acknowledged facts are not lost; (4) generated count is non-zero/exact and a removed boundary or neutralized production guard reddens the named row; (5) pnpm exec tsc -p tests/fault/store/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec vitest run tests/fault/store exits 0.
- Not in scope: disaster-restore slot/install proofs already owned by task-0c89476b.

CHILD D — Runtime effect fault schedules
- Owned files: tests/fault/runtime/runtime-fault-cases.ts, runtime-fault-matrix.test.ts, tsconfig.json.
- Production surfaces: composed dispatcher, runner activateEffect/consumeActivationGrant/validateActivationCommit, platform lock/process boundary, classifyCrash/admitResume, Claude/Codex adapters, scheduler resource/provider-slot/budget authority, and concrete artifact store.
- DoD: (1) exact production-registry cases cover registration, claim, lock, activation, physical start, result, ack, cancel, invalidate and recovery in BEFORE/AFTER/RACE orderings; (2) provider death/hang/truncate/corrupt/path-swap and resource UNKNOWN cross-products assert stable reason+layer and precise recovery set; (3) one authoritative effect, no duplicate launch/resource/slot/budget spend, and no hidden skip are proven by durable read-back; (4) off-host physical facts remain typed UNKNOWN; host-malicious behavior remains outside scope; (5) pnpm exec tsc -p tests/fault/runtime/tsconfig.json && pnpm exec vitest run tests/fault/runtime exits 0.

CHILD E — Fault/security gate lane
- Owned files (scope amendment required): package.json, tests/fault/tsconfig.json, tests/security/tsconfig.json.
- Runs after A-D and includes every existing sibling test without editing DONE Foundation or blocked disaster/Linux/macOS paths.
- Scripts are shell-neutral: each runs tsc -p <lane tsconfig> && vitest run <lane>, with passWithNoTests false inherited from Vitest. Root recursive typecheck alone is not evidence.
- DoD: all lane files are covered by strict NodeNext compilation, discovery is non-zero, pnpm test:fault and pnpm test:security both exit 0 on Windows, and no POSIX-only syntax is introduced.

EVENTUAL PARENT task-05ce9b8f plan (2 new aggregate test files, <=7 steps)
1. Re-verify pinned design/benchmark hashes, frozen source commit, and every named production/test prerequisite task DONE and consumer-reachable; no edits and no confirmatory corpus access.
2. RED tests in tests/security/system/security-coverage.test.ts: import child case manifests plus the production security registry and require exact two-way set equality, every boundary's BEFORE/AFTER/RACE phases, non-zero counts, unique identities, exact code+layer, and permitted UNKNOWN/outside-scope only.
3. RED tests in tests/fault/system/fault-coverage.test.ts: same ratchet for the production fault/effect registry and schedule-checker boundary mapping; no abstract category may claim PASS without executed production evidence.
4. Implement only the minimal aggregate fixture wiring in those two files; do not patch production or weaken a child expectation. A discovered production defect becomes a named prerequisite task.
5. One adversarial pass: neutralize one production refusal per layer and require the corresponding test to fail; remove one generated case in-memory and require exact-set/non-vacuity failure; restore by exact committed hash.
6. Single final verification step: record repo-wide baseline/HEAD path-attributed failures, then run the task's exact fresh command pnpm test:fault && pnpm test:security; owned lanes must be exit 0.
7. Submit only exact development evidence for the frozen source commit. Missing/corrupt/unverifiable evidence stays UNKNOWN; GO_QUIESCE and GO_ACTIVATE remain separate and no confirmatory corpus bytes are created/viewed.

Parent affected files: tests/security/system/security-coverage.test.ts and tests/fault/system/fault-coverage.test.ts. Final verification: pnpm test:fault && pnpm test:security.
